criteria.stable_correct_definition: A probe is stable+correct if >= 5/6 runs parse as Python AND >= 4/6 runs match the reference (AST-equivalent or byte-equal).

probe.notes: 3/6 correct; 3/6 add defensive globals scaffolding. Description admits surface forms. Probe-precision issue, not pipeline failure.

decision.rationale: 4/5 stable+correct (P2, P3, P4, P5). Formal UNLOCK threshold is >=4. P1 at 3/6 is a description-precision issue; pipeline geometry is sound for half the runs.
